tmPrefilled.source: The Nordex Floor heater is sleek and spare in aesthetic and efficient in performance. It distributes warmth through convection or radiant heating methods and incorporates advanced energy-saving technology. It is designed for regular and frequent use, ensuring reduced energy and maintenance costs. and can accommodate 40kg to 100kg of sauna stones.
